tweets.text:
NEW: An illegal immigrant who used his position as a youth soccer coach to prey on young boys by drugging and sexually abusing them is now facing a lengthy prison sentence for his crimes.

Mexican national Camilo Campos-Hurtado, 66, received a 30-year prison sentence, along with five years of supervised release, this week for reportedly raping unconscious boys between the ages of 9 and 17. Between 2017 and 2021, Campos-Hurtado “incapacitated” his minor victims by drugging them or giving them alcohol before he sexually assaulted them and recorded the abuse.

Authorities first learned of Campos-Hurtado’s predatory behavior after employees at a Franklin, Tennessee, pizza shop found that the illegal immigrant left behind his cell phone at the business. The workers found dozens of “unconscionable videos and pictures of children” on the device.
